summary: Federal Communications Commission urges preservation of E-Rate program to support schools and libraries in providing essential broadband connectivity for students and staff. Support for the connectivity and internal network infrastructure schools need to provide reliable educational access; and Work with schools and other stakeholders to strengthen and modernize E-Rate rather than reduce its role in public education.

claims.argument: Cutting E-Rate would increase financial burdens on school districts
claims.evidence_quote: When the cost of essential infrastructure increases, districts like mine are forced to make difficult choices about staffing, instructional programs, student services, transportation, facilities, and other priorities.
